original.text: Nothing is an offence which is done by a child under seven years of age. Act of a child above seven and under twelve years of age of immature understanding.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 3: GENERAL EXCEPTIONS
Section 20: Act of a child under seven years of age.
Nothing is an offence which is done by a child under seven years of age. Act of a child above seven and under twelve years of age of immature understanding.

original.text: Nothing is an offence which is done by a child above seven years of age and under twelve years of age, who has not attained sufficient maturity of understanding to judge of the nature and consequences of his conduct on that occasion. Act of a person of unsound mind.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 3: GENERAL EXCEPTIONS
Section 21: Act of a child above seven and under twelve years of age of immature understanding.
Nothing is an offence which is done by a child above seven years of age and under twelve years of age, who has not attained sufficient maturity of understanding to judge of the nature and consequences of his conduct on that occasion. Act of a person of unsound mind.
legal_concepts: act of a child above seven and under twelve years of age of immature understanding

original.chapter_title: OF FALSE EVIDENCE AND OFFENCES AGAINST PUBLIC JUSTICE
original.text: Whoever, knowing or having reason to believe that any persons are about to commit or have recently committed robbery or dacoity, harbours them or any of them, with the intention of facilitating the commission of such robbery or dacoity, or of screening them or any of them from punishment, shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 14: OF FALSE EVIDENCE AND OFFENCES AGAINST PUBLIC JUSTICE
Section 254: Penalty for harbouring robbers or dacoits.
Whoever, knowing or having reason to believe that any persons are about to commit or have recently committed robbery or dacoity, harbours them or any of them, with the intention of facilitating the commission of such robbery or dacoity, or of screening them or any of them from punishment, shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
original.text: Whoever being the father or mother of a child under the age of twelve years, or having the care of such child, shall expose or leave such child in any place with the intention of wholly abandoning such child, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, or with fine, or with both.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 5: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
Section 93: Exposure and abandonment of child under twelve years of age, by parent or person having
Whoever being the father or mother of a child under the age of twelve years, or having the care of such child, shall expose or leave such child in any place with the intention of wholly abandoning such child, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, or with fine, or with both.

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
original.text: Whoever kidnaps or abducts any child under the age of ten years with the intention of taking dishonestly any movable property from the person of such child, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine. Selling child for purposes of prostitution, etc.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 5: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
Section 97: Kidnapping or abducting child under ten years of age with intent to steal from its person.
Whoever kidnaps or abducts any child under the age of ten years with the intention of taking dishonestly any movable property from the person of such child, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine. Selling child for purposes of prostitution, etc.

phase11.summary_answer: Section 20 states that nothing is an offence committed by a child under seven years of age.
phase11.detailed_answer: According to Section 20 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, any act done by a child under the age of seven years is not considered an offence. Additionally, it mentions that acts committed by children above seven and under twelve years of age may be considered based on their maturity of understanding.
